exposure: Race/ethnicity (NH-Asian Indian, Chinese, Filipino, Japanese, Korean, Vietnam, NH-White)
cohort: Singleton births to NH-Asian Indian, Chinese, Filipino, Japanese, Korean, Vietnam, and NH-White women documented in 2009 Texas birth certificate data (N = 150,674)
finding: Asian women had a higher risk of inadequate gestational weight gain and gestational diabetes mellitus than NH-White women, and there was heterogeneity in risks of adverse perinatal outcomes among Asian-American subgroups.
